answer_1.quote: Audio-visual text generation bridges the gap between perception (visual and auditory) and communication (via language), and is hence becoming an increasingly important goal for artificial agents... The mainstream audio-visual text generation task is video captioning...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the methods across all four commonly used metrics for video captioning: BLEU-n , METEOR , ROUGE-L (ROUGE, 2004), CIDEr .
